title: Vientiane vs Luang Prabang: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Luang Prabang for cultural tourism. Vientiane for digital nomads and local life. Do both if you have 7+ days in Laos.

categories.name: Temples & Culture
categories.summary: Luang Prabang has 33 wats and the Tak Bat alms ceremony. Vientiane has Pha That Luang and Wat Si Saket — impressive but fewer.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Luang Prabang's $1 night market buffet and khao piak sen are legendary. Vientiane has more diversity but fewer signature dishes.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Vientiane: $25–40/day budget. Luang Prabang: $35–55/day. Not a huge gap but Vientiane is consistently cheaper.

categories.name: Walkability
categories.summary: Luang Prabang's UNESCO peninsula is fully walkable. Vientiane requires tuk-tuks for most sights.

categories.name: Day Trips & Nature
categories.summary: Kuang Si Falls and Pak Ou Caves are among Southeast Asia's best day trips from Luang Prabang. Vientiane's Buddha Park is fun but less dramatic.

categories.name: Digital Nomad Life
categories.summary: Vientiane edges ahead: more expat cafes, lower costs, and a real-city routine.

faq.question: Is Vientiane or Luang Prabang better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Luang Prabang — the UNESCO heritage town, alms-giving ceremony, Kuang Si Falls, and night market deliver a more memorable experience.

faq.question: How far is Vientiane from Luang Prabang?
faq.answer: About 2 hours by the China-Laos Railway ($15–25) or 40 minutes by air ($40–80 one-way).
